MATCH (m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019})
WHERE m.round = 'SF' AND ((m)-[:WON]->(:Player {id: 103819}) OR (m)-[:LOST]->(:Player {id: 103819}))
AND ((m)-[:WON]->(:Player {id: 104745}) OR (m)-[:LOST]->(:Player {id: 104745}))
MATCH (b:Bookmaker {name: 'Pinnacle'})-[:PRICED]->(m)
RETURN m.id AS match_id, b.name AS bookmaker, m.p1_odds AS p1_odds, m.p2_odds AS p2_odds

MATCH (p1:Player {id:103819})-[:WON|LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name:'Wimbledon',year:2019})
WHERE m.round='SF'
MATCH (p2:Player {id:104745})-[:WON|LOST]->(m)
MATCH (winner:Player)-[:WON]->(m)
MATCH (loser:Player)-[:LOST]->(m)
MATCH (b:Bookmaker {name:'Pinnacle'})-[:PRICED]->(m)
RETURN m.id AS match_id, winner.name AS winner_name, loser.name AS loser_name, b.name AS bookmaker, m.winnerOdds AS winner_odds, m.loserOdds AS loser_odds

WHERE m.round='SF' AND ((m)-[:WON]->(:Player {id:103819}) OR (m)-[:LOST]->(:Player {id:103819}))
